_about: EchoCombat's values, in the shape of the game's mp_weapon_settings.json. Every deploy / release merges them into the game's own mp_weapon_settings (packed with the rest of the game data, so change a value here, then deploy or make the release again). The OVERCHARGE keys the game itself does not use (damage_bonus_*, head_body_part, cheat_death_*, link_window_ms, heal_fraction) are also written into PowerBoost.ini for the plugin.
